title.en: Chapter 2 — A Photograph in Someone Else’s Hands

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: الملك حكى إنه كان يعرف مغنية اسمها آيرين آدلر.
sentences.en: The king explained that he had known a singer named Irene Adler.
And she has a photograph of the two of them together.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا رح أتزوج، وهاي الصورة بتخرب كل إشي.
sentences.en: He said: I am to be married, and this photograph ruins everything.

sentences.ar: جربت أشتريها، وجربت أسرقها، وما نفع.
sentences.en: I tried to buy it, and I tried to steal it, and nothing worked.
Holmes asked: and she, does she want money?

sentences.ar: قال الملك: لأ. هي بدها بس تمنعني.
sentences.en: The king said: no. She only wants to stop me.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: يعني احنا قدام واحدة بتفكر منيح.
sentences.en: Holmes said: then we are facing a woman who thinks well.
